content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jadavpur University Intern Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Jadavpur University for filling up vacant positions through a direct walk-in interview process scheduled in Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released for the recruitment of the Intern post under a contractual government job arrangement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in total?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Intern position at Jadavpur University as per the current notification details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Intern post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech degree in Electrical Engineering to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly need to attend the interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Jadavpur University Intern recruitment is officially scheduled to take place on 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit allowed for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Intern position is 30 years. Please check official guidelines for any relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Intern position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Intern post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 50/- is applicable for both General/OBC as well as SC/ST candidate categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidate who clears the walk-in interview process will be Kolkata, West Bengal (Pincode: 700032).
